name: Internal Snapping Hip Syndrome
definition: Audible or palpable anterior hip snapping, usually caused by iliopsoas tendon movement over anterior bony structures.

investigations.principle: Dynamic ultrasound can demonstrate snapping; MRI is used when intra-articular pathology is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, tendon, cartilage, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent disabling snapping may require injection or surgical lengthening/release.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Shroni-Snayu mechanical phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Audible or palpable anterior hip snapping, usually caused by iliopsoas tendon movement over anterior bony structures.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
